import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import re
from collections import Counter

def task_func(mystrings, text):
    if text is None or (isinstance(text, str) and text.strip() == ""):
        raise ValueError("Input text is empty")

    if mystrings is None:
        items = []
    elif isinstance(mystrings, str):
        items = [mystrings]
    else:
        try:
            items = list(mystrings)
        except TypeError:
            items = [mystrings]

    modified_words = [
        re.sub(r" ", "_", str(word).casefold())
        for word in items
    ]

    counts = Counter(modified_words)
    unique_words_in_order = list(dict.fromkeys(modified_words))

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    x = np.arange(len(unique_words_in_order))
    y = [counts[word] for word in unique_words_in_order]

    ax.bar(x, y)
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(unique_words_in_order, rotation=45, ha="right")
    ax.set_xlabel("Words")
    ax.set_ylabel("Frequency")

    plt.tight_layout()
    return ax
